cases.name: testUnclaimedRightsAndClaimedDebtFollowTransferredID
cases.purpose: Already received but unclaimed rewards follow the transferred ID while its historical claimed debt remains intact.

cases.name: testTransferBeforeAnyClaimGivesEntireHistoryToNewHolder
cases.purpose: A recipient of an ID with no prior claim can receive that ID's complete accrued reward history.

scope: Local mock contracts only. No RPC, .env loading, signing or broadcasting; does not establish that a positive pre-transfer Vault claimable balance was exercised on mainnet.
